summary: Wrote a four-phase implementation plan from the research report's measured findings. Because POST /v1/cli/context ignores the project field it is sent and returns no per-item attribution, no local filter or wrapper is buildable: the plan instead records all three primary-session injection sites by name in a new source-store domain note, ships a read-only probe script that makes the residual falsifiable, amends the existing domain/README/EXTENSION surfaces, and closes with a deploy plus full gate run and a five-criterion acceptance walkthrough. No phase suppresses or narrows any hook, preserving the cross-corpus abstraction class.

artifacts.summary: Four-phase plan: new injection-site domain note, residual-monitor probe script, domain/README/EXTENSION amendments, deploy + full gate + acceptance walkthrough.
